Statistics for Rotisserie Baseball Auction Leagues

Source: R/rotostats-package.R
rotostats-package.Rd

Provides tools for calculating statistics and player valuations in rotisserie baseball auction leagues. Designed to support auction drafts, in-season roster decisions, and end-of-season analysis.
